explication: UI for Apache Kafka is a web application for monitoring and managing Kafka clusters. The user-facing workflow is to inspect cluster resources and perform operational actions; major capabilities also include message browsing/production, schema management, Connect, ksqlDB, metrics, authentication/RBAC, and masking. The tree and excerpts support the backend topic/admin-client and RBAC relationships shown here. Other documented capabilities are represented as subsystems, but their internal call paths are not inferred from filenames alone.
